result.summary: Found several visual/content bugs: a broken delivery fee showing '€NaN', truncated restaurant names, and a partially cut-off category chip, plus incomplete promo banner visibility.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows delivery fee as '€NaN delivery', indicating a null/undefined price was formatted as currency.
issues.suggestion: Handle missing delivery fees with a fallback (e.g. 'Free', '—', or hide the fee) and fix the data/formatting so NaN never reaches the UI.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated with no ellipsis or full-name affordance in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles, use text ellipsis with tooltip/full name on tap, or widen/adjust the card so the full name fits.

issues.description: The category filter chips row is cut off on the right (partial 'Healthy' and next chip), with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll is obvious (fade, peek of next chip, or padding) and that chips aren’t clipped awkwardly at the screen edge.

issues.description: Bottom of the pizza promo card and top content feel cramped against the tab bar; the last card is heavily cropped.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding above the tab bar so cards and text aren’t cut off while scrolling.

issues.description: Promo banner decorative circles and green overlay make the secondary line slightly harder to scan, though still readable.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast or simplify the background pattern behind the promo body text for clearer hierarchy.
